Figure 9.19
To get the security access, the
DSD
submodule has to call the
DSP
submodule to get
the seed value from the application. If no error is detected, the seed value is sent in
the positive response.
In a second step, the
DSP
submodule gets the key calculated by the tester and requests
the application to compare this key with the internal calculated key. If no error occurs,
the new access type is set in the
DSL
submodule and a positive response is sent.
